craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 37. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 6. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: Then the living soul brought by the net method stands as if asleep, from absence of obtaining apparatus of mind-endowed body and the rest.
l4.sanskrit_cite: tato jālakramānītaḥ sa jīvaḥ suptavatsthitaḥ manoviśiṣṭadehādisāmagrīprāptyabhāvataḥ
